title: Faro
description: Analogue photographs from Faro by Bart Mulder: beach houses, boats on the shore and boardwalks through the dunes, all shot on film.

images.alt: A sandy beachside landscape with a small house featuring brown shutters and a red-tiled roof, a wooden pathway, a utility pole with power lines, and a blue sky with wispy clouds.
A person with a dog walking along a wooden boardwalk through sandy dunes with green vegetation, utility poles, and a fence, near a body of water under a partly cloudy sky.
Bridge with a wavy design over water, sandy shore in foreground, airplane in sky, cloudy sky with mountains in background.
A boat covered with a tarp resting on the shore of a river or estuary during low tide with a city skyline in the distance under a partly cloudy sky.
An airplane flying in the sky above palm trees, with some clouds visible.
Empty restaurant with tables and chairs, sunlight casting shadows, located near windows with outside view.

A white building with small rectangular windows and a door, with green ground cover plants in front. On the roof, there is industrial ventilation equipment including a large chimney and flexible duct pipe.
White stone monument of three soldiers in uniform, standing back to back, under partly cloudy sky.
A sandy beach with scattered boats pulled up on the shore, some water patches, and a few buildings and palm trees in the distance under a cloudy sky.
A pink plastic chair inside an outdoor enclosure with green walls and a small window on the wall, beside a small plant.
Red vintage Mercedes-Benz car parked on the side of a rural road with green bushes and a clear blue sky in the background.
View through the windshield of a vehicle showing boats on a beach near a body of water, with a distant shoreline and buildings in the background.
